snippet.title: Hypnorynth Trailer
snippet.description:
You are pursued by a malevolent entity.
You must enter the maze, meet its strange inhabitants and uncover its secrets if you hope to make it out alive.
will you escape the... Hypnorynth?

A 3d, first person horror adventure game from Sojioto, a h e n t a x, and Michael Gray.

Full game:
https://sojioto.itch.io/hypnorynth

Music by Matt Goetz:
https://itch.io/profile/mikegoetz

Submitted to Scream Jam 2023:
https://itch.io/jam/scream-jam-2023

Submitted to Cosmic Horrors Jam II:
https://itch.io/jam/cosmichorrorsjam2
